verdict.rationale: React's official docs say React Native and Expo let you build apps in React for Android and iOS with truly native UIs, and the GitHub README confirms React powers mobile apps via React Native. Community commentary praises React Native's learn-once-write-anywhere model for high-quality native apps, though an early comment noted Android lagged iOS at launch. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation or benchmarks on native mobile performance, evidence of current iOS/Android parity, and clarity that the capability comes through the separate React Native/Expo projects rather than core React.
